reviews.review_description:
It is so refreshing to find a hidden gem like this, story adventures are my favourite type of game, scary story adventures are even better & let me tell you I jumped from the first minute. Definitely more scary than horror so this should appeal to most people.
Love the premise of the story, the Chinese vibe is evident throughout the game with lovely tender moments set to a canvas back drop.
The monsters in the game are truly two of a kind, how can someone blind that frightening to sneak past.
Overall an incredible experience and at the price point an absolute bargain.
Highly recommended.

developer_response.body: Thank you for such a thoughtful review! We’re thrilled that the story, Chinese-inspired atmosphere, tender moments, and terrifying monsters made Bamboo Grove feel like a hidden gem. Knowing the game had you jumping from the very first minute made our day! Thank you for playing, recommending it, and appreciating everything we put into the experience.

reviews.review_description: Seriously creepy freaky fun game play, one of the best horror games I've played in a long time, its got some escape room game play and being sneaky moving about.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much! We’re thrilled you are enjoying Bamboo Grove. Hearing that Bamboo Grove is one of the best horror games you’ve played in a long time truly means a lot to our team. Thanks for playing and stay sneaky!

reviews.review_description: OK, I just got through the first part of the gamer, got back to the developer office and about to start the next game session and I'm very impressed. It has a few rough corners to be smoothest out but it plays very well, has a nice creepy atmosphere, good sound effects too. I'll recommend it if you like the genre and I love it! Ignore the 1 star review. It's not an accurate description of the game.

Game is excellent with an horror theme and dark environment. Thrilling story line which is a diversion from routine shooters and puzzles. Environment are well detailed although graphics could be improved with a future quest 3 specific graphics update. Disregard any one or two star reviews. This is not a 1 or 2 star game. Low quality reviews are likely related to personal bias with the developer and not necessarily true. Great work by the way. Strongly recommended.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your support and recommendation! We’re thrilled that you enjoyed the dark atmosphere and story-driven horror experience. We also appreciate your suggestion for a Quest 3 graphics update and will share it with the development team.  It means a lot that Bamboo Grove connected with you. Thank you for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review!

reviews.review_description:
As a horror fan I was really looking forward to this. It looked like something I'd love based on the trailer.

It's an interesting idea for a game, but this seems like a rough proof of concept.

The graphics rendering is very poor. Muddy textures, primitive lighting, low poly models. There are a lot of Quest 1 games with far better graphics. Switching the shadow rendering option on seems to do nothing because lights still don't cast shadows.

Despite the low fidelity graphics the performance is poor with frequent stutters and hitches. (I played it on the Quest 3.) 

Other issues:

Subtitles jiggle around when you move.

Smooth turning is very slow which may trigger nausea in some people. There's no speed adjustment. (I don't use smooth tuning on Quest but I wanted to test it.)

The VR interactions are generally janky and occasionally glitchy. Sometimes objects get stuck in scenery when trying to pick them up.

I'm requesting a refund.

developer_response.body:
Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We’re sorry Bamboo Grove didn’t meet your expectations, especially as a horror fan who was looking forward to it.

Your concerns about the visuals, lighting, Quest 3 performance, unstable subtitles, turning speed, and object interactions have all been noted and shared with the development team. This kind of specific feedback genuinely helps us understand where the experience needs improvement.

We completely understand your decision to request a refund. We’ll continue working to improve the game, and we hope a future update may earn a second look and leave you with a much better impression of Bamboo Grove.

reviews.review_description:
This isn't just a generic jump-scare fest. It’s a super immersive psychological horror! 
This is my first time playing a Chinese-style horror game in VR, and it feels incredibly fresh but also gives you this intense mental pressure. For 80% of the game, it completely avoids explicit gore or mutated monsters. Instead, just being surrounded by the endless bamboo forest, the sudden downpours, or a ghostly shadow flickering behind a yellowed wooden window was enough to give me absolute chills. 
The sound design is a total masterpiece, completely maximizing VR's immersion with spatial audio—the entire atmosphere just feels so incredibly creepy. 
For the price, the quality of this game is an absolute steal. I really hope it becomes a massive hit!
